plain: Guided by a sense of right and wrong; careful

webster.text: Influenced by conscience; governed by a strict regard to the dictates of conscience, or by the known or supposed rules of right and wrong; as a conscientious judge.

more.text: Regulated by conscience; according to the dictates of conscience; as a conscientious probity.

example.quote: As to religion, I hold it to be the indispensible duty of government to protect all conscientious professors thereof, and I know of no other business which government hath to do therewith.
